ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement without HDI's consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, an acquisition or a sale of substantially all assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement without the Company's prior written consent, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of the Company. HDI shall have no right to terminate this Agreement as a result of a change of control of the Company.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 binds successors and assigns but does not regulate assignment, so HDI could transfer this development and hosting engagement to anyone, including a competitor. We have added one short sentence pair confirming we may assign to an affiliate or M&A successor without consent while HDI's assignment needs our prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld and never to a competitor; we can discuss a mutual consent-with-notice fallback if preferred.
proposal.summary: Insert concise assignment terms: our affiliate/successor carve-out, HDI assignment only with our consent (never to a competitor), and no HDI termination on our change of control.
